Definition: Laban, a Mesopotamian; also a place in the Desert
BiblicalUsage: Laban = "white"; n pr m; 1) son of Bethuel, brother of Rebekah, and father of Leah and Rachel; n pr loc; 2) a wilderness encampment of the Israelites
